findings.suggested_fix: Drop AC4 as an acceptance criterion and record REQ-16 as a delivery constraint traced in the story notes, or rephrase as a checkable outcome (e.g. existing AppointmentTable column logic is reused, no duplicate column added).
findings.text: S-1 AC4 is not testable: it describes how the change is made (keep existing code, add only missing behaviour) rather than an observable outcome, and its Then is self-referential to S-1 to S-6.

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-3 into filter, date range and paging stories, or note why they are kept together.
findings.text: S-3 bundles three separate outcomes (status filter, date range, paging); each could be its own small story.

rubric_items.reason: All 18 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-18) are traced by at least one story; no assumed REQs exist.
Most stories carry one outcome, but S-3 bundles status filter, date range and paging, and S-1 mixes the UI column with the REQ-16 verify-existing process constraint.
ACs are Given/When/Then and discriminating (60 vs 61 char boundary, each non-Cancelled status, other pages); S-1 AC4 is a process statement with no observable outcome.
60 and the ellipsis come from REQ-4; 'one character longer than 60' is derived inline; example reason text is test data, not a limit.
Clear, consistent terms matching the intent and glossary (Cancelled, own page, Cancellation reason cell).
